title: C++: Context Manager
description: Implement a context manager using RAII that logs enter/exit of a scope.

steps.title: Context Manager
steps.description: Create a ScopeGuard class that executes a function when it goes out of scope. Also create a Context class that prints 'Enter [name]' on construction and 'Exit [name]' on destruction.
hints: Context(string n) : name(n) { cout << "Enter " << name << endl; } ~Context() { cout << "Exit " << name << endl; }

verification.test: output.includes('Enter main') && output.includes('Working') && output.includes('Cleanup') && output.includes('Exit main')
verification.failureMessage: Show enter, work, cleanup, exit order
